title: A Colony for the Vector
author: Coral Galloway
blurb: Vesper Marchetti, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
